---
title: "CUDA-MPPI"
---

## Overview

A high-performance CUDA backend for Model Predictive Path Integral control. Provides massively parallel trajectory sampling on NVIDIA GPUs for real-time nonlinear control.

## Tech Stack

- **Languages:** CUDA, C++
- **Methods:** MPPI, parallel trajectory sampling
